relatedSnapshot.title: Support chat after hours: the customer asked for a person
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Customer report

```text
The customer asked for a person after hours and wrote: I'd like to speak with a human representative about the White Label Partner Program.

I currently have Acquisity Pro for my AI Growth Experts HQ agency and plan to manage multiple client campaigns.

Could you explain the partner pricing, how many client workspaces are included, whether clients can access only their own campaigns and email replies, and whether my existing Pro subscription and purchased domains/inboxes can be used?

I'm looking for the most cost-effective way to manage multiple clients under my agency without purchasing a full Pro subscription for each one.

Foreman's reply: 1. The White Label Partner Program allows you to add client workspaces, customize branding, and set which tools your clients see in their sidebar, but specific partner pricing tiers and workspace inclusions are not listed in the help center [1].

2. In the White Label program, clients log in through your branded portal and see only their own assigned workspace, keeping them completely separated from other clients' workspaces and data [2].

3. Client users see the Client Portal by default, and partners can manage tool access through the Partner Panel [3]. However, Client roles only get access to the AI SDR if enabled for the workspace, and Member roles give full tool access [4][5].

4. Existing email accounts and inboxes can be moved between workspaces using the bulk move feature in the Email Accounts section, but I am not sure of the exact billing details regarding reusing your main Pro subscription across partner workspaces [6].

Our support team is currently away. Their standard hours are Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM Eastern Time, with no upcoming holiday closures scheduled for the next 90 days.
```

Foreman's reply: To set up the AI SDR to automatically process incoming campaign replies, answer questions, and book meetings on your calendar:

1. Click "Settings" at the bottom of the sidebar, then click "Email & Calendar" to connect your Name 4 or Outlook calendar.
2. Click "Conferencing" under "Personal" settings to add your static meeting link or connect your Zoom account [1].
3. Click "Availability" under "Personal" settings to set your timezone, daily meeting windows, and buffer times [2].
4. Click "AI SDR Agent" under "Workspace" settings, select your call handler, and add your concrete business facts, pricing, and escalation rules into the "Knowledge Base" text box [1].
5. Turn on "Auto Agent Run" on the "AI SDR Agent" page to enable automatic replies across your campaigns [3].

If you hit any errors or your settings are already configured, tap the magnifying glass next to the message box and send your message again to have your account investigated.

## Customer report

```text
The customer asked for a person after hours and wrote: i think a person needs to address this.  I have mentioned it many many times with no resolution

Foreman's reply: Leads ordered through AI Lead Search are only delivered if they pass live email verification. Leads that cannot be verified, fail validation, or match existing workspace contacts are dropped and not delivered [1].

Lead credits are charged only when AI Lead Search delivers verified leads [2]. Building, editing, and retrying websites in the AI Name 7 uses website credits from your workspace balance, which are separate from lead credits [3].

When an AI Name 7 site generation fails or gets stuck, try the following steps:

1. In the left sidebar, click "Sites" and open your website [4].
2. In the preview toolbar, click "Fix with AI" or ask the chat sidebar to fix the build without changing the design.
3. Select the successful version in the version dropdown and click "Publish" [5].

If you see a specific error message on the site build or lead search, let me know what it says.
```

relatedSnapshot.title: Support chat after hours: the customer asked for a person
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Customer report

```text
The customer asked for a person after hours and wrote: I was told the domains and inboxes had to be refunded due to them not being provisioned within a certain time. I have purchased new inboxes for this workspace this morning, and received a notice saying they were successfully provisioned. However when I go in now it says the domain could not be loaded, and the inboxes show warm up but there are no warmup emails being sent.

This no longer seems like a payment or renewal issue, as this is the second time this week I have purchased inboxes with the same outcome - we have been querying this on the workspace chat for a few days with no proper resolution

Foreman's reply: When inboxes stay on initial warmup with zero emails sent, or show errors after provisioning, you can try reconnecting them or giving the system time to initialize.

1. In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", then click "Email Accounts".
2. Check the "Status" column for the affected inboxes.
3. If an inbox shows "Error", click that inbox row to open its side panel, then click "Reconnect" [1].
4. If an inbox shows "Warmup" with an orange flame, zero emails or a dash for the health score can be normal during the first 24 to 48 hours after purchase [2].

Since this is an account-specific problem that has persisted, tap the magnifying glass next to the message box and send your message again to have your account investigated.
```

I am not sure of a way to manually edit or change the email subject line when replying from the inbox, as the help center does not describe a setting to change thread subjects for manual replies.

If you would like to have your account investigated to see why different subjects were sent on the thread, tap the magnifying glass next to the message box and send your message again to have your account investigated.
